sloka: विसञ्ज्ञं वानरं दृष्ट्वा दशग्रीवो रणोत्सुकः ।रथेनाम्बुदनादेन सौमित्रिमभिदुद्रुवे ।। ६.५९.९२ ।।।।
transliteration: visañjñaṁ vānaraṁ dṛṣṭvā daśagrīvo raṇotsukaḥ ।rathenāmbudanādena saumitrimabhidudruve ।। 6.59.92 ।।।।

translations.english: By virtue of his father's greatness and his own power, his life did not cease but he fell on the ground.
